statement.p: (a) Find a unit vector from the point P=(2,1) and toward the point Q=(10,16).
(b) Find a vector of length 51 pointing in the same direction.

static.solution:
(a) The displacement from P to Q is given by \overrightarrow{PQ} = (10\,\vec i + 16\,\vec j) - (2\,\vec i + 1\,\vec j) = 8\,\mathit{\vec i}+15\,\mathit{\vec j}. Since \mbox{len}{\overrightarrow{PQ}} = \sqrt{8^2 + 15^2} = 17, a unit vector \vec u in the direction of \overrightarrow{PQ} is given by \vec u = \frac{1}{17}\,\overrightarrow{PQ} = \frac{1}{17}\,(8\,\mathit{\vec i}+15\,\mathit{\vec j}) .
(b) A vector of length 51 pointing in the same direction is given by 51\,\vec u = \frac{51}{17}\,(8\,\mathit{\vec i}+15\,\mathit{\vec j}) = 24\,\mathit{\vec i}+45\,\mathit{\vec j}.
